_comment: Roost configuration. Edit this file (not the .js source) to tune behavior. Restart the server after changing.
_statements_dir: Folder holding the year subfolders (2024/, 2025/, ...), relative to this roost/ folder. Defaults to ../Statements; falls back to the Commissions root if that folder has no year folders.
_ma_reclass: Medicare Advantage new-business detection. A residual-section line is reclassified as new business when its payable is >= mult x the policy's typical recurring payment AND >= max(floor_min, 3 x global median). Raise mult/floor_min to reclassify fewer lines.
